senses.gloss:
The affix अ comes after a verb which has a prosodially heavy vowel and ends in a consonant when the word to be formed is feminine.

Terms: अ

In the room of a prosodially long vowel (with the exception of ऋ) though it may not stand at the end, there is substituted a प्लुत for one at a time, under the above circumstances -- प्रत्यभिवादेशूद्रे ८.२.८३ & दूराद्धूते च ८.२.८४, in the opinion of Eastern Grammarians.

Terms: प्लुत
